video_title: Cavs Practice | Jarrett Allen Media Availability | 10.19.2026

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the evolving chemistry between Evan Mobley and James
quotes.excerpt: Evan keeps on improving. He keeps on getting better and better, adding things to his game.
quotes.quote: It is growing exponentially because Evan keeps on improving. He keeps on getting better and better, adding things to his game. We already know what James is capable of. He is capable of improving a player to their highest standards. So it has just been incredible. James goes to the basket, throws a lob to Evan, or even Evan handling and James setting it. It is an incredible pairing.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says the chemistry between Evan Mobley and James is growing exponentially. He notes that James is capable of improving a player to their highest standards and calls the duo an incredible pairing.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on the defensive versatility of James
quotes.excerpt: His switchability and his willing to do the dirty work.
quotes.quote: His switchability and his willing to do the dirty work. We were talking, he is like, after every play, we have something positive to say about how we guarded the pick-and-roll or just any action that we were guarding. So just his ability to guard one through five.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen praises the defensive versatility of James, highlighting his switchability and willingness to do the dirty work. Allen notes that James has the ability to guard one through five.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on his pick-and-roll chemistry with Donovan Mitchell
quotes.excerpt: I feel like Donovan and I have a good pairing. I get him open and he finds me.
quotes.quote: Pair well. At one point when we were together, it was either Kenny or JB was talking about we have the number one pick-and-roll in the NBA. So at that point, I feel like Donovan and I have a good pairing. I get him open and he finds me. We just work well off of each other.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says he and Donovan Mitchell continue to work well off each other, noting that at one point they were considered the number one pick and roll duo in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Mario Hezonja's adjustment to the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think it is a big adjustment for somebody that comes from a different style of basketball.
quotes.quote: I think he is doing excellent. I think it is a big adjustment for somebody that comes from a different style of basketball to the NBA basketball especially. But he has things he still needs to learn, but he has things that he excels at as well. When he drives to the basket, he is able to find a cutter. I know during the game we had a play where he posted up and he found me on the roll for a floater. So he is doing very well for somebody that comes from EuroLeague.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says Mario Hezonja is doing excellent in his adjustment to the NBA. Allen notes that while Hezonja still has things to learn, he excels at finding cutters when he drives to the basket.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Mario Hezonja's offensive strengths
quotes.excerpt: His ability to drive and his gravity when he drives, I think that is one of his best attributes.
quotes.quote: His ability to drive and his gravity when he drives, I think that is one of his best attributes, especially on offense. When he drives, he is a bowling ball when he goes downhill. People are going to need to come and help to stop him. And then we have seen him pass the ball very well. He still needs to learn the defenders are coming to help, NBA basketball like we talked about, but his ability to drive and create gravity is incredible.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen describes Mario Hezonja as a bowling ball when he goes downhill. Allen says Hezonja's ability to drive and create gravity is incredible for the offense.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Evan Mobley's continuous improvement
quotes.excerpt: Whenever you are able to see a player go into practice and do things that you never seen.
quotes.quote: Whenever you are able to see a player go into practice and do things that you never seen them do before and improve every single year, it makes it a lot easier for you to have faith in us. And that is what everybody sees in this building. Every single year he comes back and shows us something new, and now it is just time for him to apply it to the game, which we all know and believe he will.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says Evan Mobley shows the team something new every single year. He notes that seeing Mobley improve in practice makes it easy for the team to have faith in his development.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on Evan Mobley's ball-handling development
quotes.excerpt: His ball-handling. That has been something he has been working on since his rookie year.
quotes.quote: His ball-handling. That has been something he has been working on since his rookie year and I truly believe every year and especially this year it is improving.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen says Evan Mobley has been working on his ball handling since his rookie year and believes it is continuing to improve this season.

quotes.speaker: Jarrett Allen
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarrett Allen on managing pressure and expectations
quotes.excerpt: Accept the fact that there is no running away from it.
quotes.quote: I think you look at it, understand that the pressure is there, that we all know that there is a real pressure on us, and accept the fact that there is no running away from it and accept the fact that we have worked our whole careers to be in the position that we are in now and just face it head on going forward.
quotes.social_post: Jarrett Allen on the pressure facing the Cavaliers this season: We have to accept the fact that there is no running away from it and just face it head on going forward.
